# TOOLS coding and creator-agent instructions

When a task concerns YouTube channel strategy, historical stories, trending research, video or Shorts creation, competitor/outlier analysis, titles, thumbnails, scripts, YouTube SEO, analytics or publishing metadata:

1. Read .agents/skills/youtube-growth-research/SKILL.md before starting.
2. Follow the free-first research, historical verification, SEO packaging and rights/licensing workflows specified there.
3. Use niche-finder and YouTube Marketing Skills only if their local service/MCP connection is actually configured and accessible. Otherwise use verifiable free sources.
4. Never spend vidIQ credits or paid API resources by default. Do not invent YouTube metrics, fabricate citations, or claim uploads that were not completed.
5. Preserve the existing 2D video pipeline under video/history_studio/ and do not overwrite assets without checking their usage.

For tasks unrelated to YouTube content or the history studio, do not load this specialist skill.
